name: PM-KISAN
description: Financial support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families.
details: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi provides income support to eligible landholding farmer families through direct benefit transfers.

name: Post Matric Scholarship
description: Scholarship assistance for eligible students studying after matriculation.
details: Post Matric Scholarship programmes support eligible students from specified categories to continue their education after matriculation.
benefits: Financial assistance according to applicable scholarship guidelines
eligibility: Income and course conditions may apply
Must be enrolled in an eligible institution

name: PM Mudra Yojana
description: Provides loans through participating lenders to eligible micro and small business enterprises.
details: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana supports eligible non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises through participating lending institutions.
benefits: Shishu, Kishore, Tarun and TarunPlus categories

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Government health assurance scheme for eligible beneficiary families.
details: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana provides cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalisation coverage to eligible beneficiary families.
benefits: Cashless hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals, subject to scheme rules
eligibility: Beneficiary status should be checked through the official portal
documents: Other documents required by authorised centres

name: PM Awas Yojana - Urban
description: Housing assistance for eligible urban households.
details: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban supports eligible urban households through housing-related assistance under applicable programme components.
benefits: Assistance as per applicable scheme guidelines
eligibility: Must meet applicable household eligibility conditions
Other conditions depend on the programme component

name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin
description: Housing support for eligible rural households.
details: PMAY-G aims to provide assistance for pucca houses to eligible rural households identified under applicable government criteria.
benefits: Financial assistance as per rural housing guidelines
eligibility: Selection based on applicable government identification criteria

name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGA
description: Wage employment opportunities for eligible rural households.
details: MGNREGA provides a legal guarantee of wage employment to rural households whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work.
benefits: Up to 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per rural household, subject to the Act
eligibility: Must be willing to undertake unskilled manual work
Job card and local registration requirements apply
documents: Bank or post office account details

name: e-Shram
description: National database and registration platform for eligible unorganised workers.
details: The e-Shram portal helps create a national database of unorganised workers and supports access to relevant government welfare services.
benefits: Access to applicable worker-related government services
documents: Mobile number linked to Aadhaar, where required

name: National Social Assistance Programme
description: Social assistance programmes for eligible vulnerable citizens.
details: NSAP provides social assistance through eligible pension and family benefit programmes for vulnerable sections of society.
benefits: Assistance according to applicable pension programme rules
eligibility: Must meet the relevant programme conditions
Age and household criteria may apply

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
description: An initiative promoting the protection, education and empowerment of girls.
details: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao works to address gender discrimination and promote the education and empowerment of girls.
benefits: Awareness and support initiatives under the programme
eligibility: Programme activities are implemented through designated departments
Specific services depend on local programme implementation
documents: Documents depend on the specific service being accessed
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Skill India Digital Hub
description: Discover skill development, training and learning opportunities.
details: Skill India Digital Hub provides access to skill development courses, training information and related learning opportunities.
benefits: Training and course opportunities as listed on the portal
eligibility: Age and education requirements vary by course

name: Stand-Up India
description: Bank loan support for eligible women and SC/ST entrepreneurs.
details: Stand-Up India facilitates bank loans for eligible SC/ST and women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Eligible bank loans under applicable programme conditions
documents: Financial documents required by the bank
